subject: Stock write off Auto OC closure stock transfer configuration

candidates.text:
Stock write off Auto OC closure stock transfer configuration:
1. Company.
2. General site (In case you want to use multiple site configuration)
3. Write off site (click on hyper link and select from site - to site)
4. Category.
5. Stock Rule(OC stock transfer out of system / Oc stock unreserve)
6. Transaction type (FPPO)
7. Execution type (Factory/ Outsource)
After enabling this configuration once the OC is closed all the leftover stock will be transfer to the write off site.
Once the given configuration is done you don’t need to use the miscellaneous setting Enable Write off for Site:

chunks.text:
Stock write off Auto OC closure stock transfer configuration:
Angular screen for OC Closure setup & Field input types.
Navigation: - Admin >> Configurator >> Configuration rules >> OC Closure Setup
• Add a new submenu in Admin > Configurator > Configuration Rules menu, name of the submenu will be OC Closure Setup
From backend need to enable new consumption marking.
Creation of Write off site under site master.
So that material can be transfer to the write off site directly.
Under Oc closure setup you need to select the flowing details:
• Company.
• General site (In case you want to use multiple site configuration)
• Write off site (click on hyper link and select from site - to site)
• Category.
• Stock Rule(OC stock transfer out of system / Oc stock unreserve)
• Transaction type (FPPO)
• Execution type (Factory/ Outsource)
After enabling this configuration once the OC is closed all the leftover stock will be transfer to the write off site.
Once the given configuration is done you don’t need to use the miscellaneous setting Enable Write off for Site:
